change_triggers: Revenue growth falls materially below 15.7% or operating-income growth turns negative.
Operating margin falls below 35% or operating cash-flow growth reverses materially.
views.thesis: Strong revenue, operating-profit and operating-cash-flow growth, supported by a 35.4% operating margin and 47.7% ROE, merits a strong overweight. The main offset is 3.30x liabilities-to-equity leverage, although long-term debt is only 20.2% of assets.

change_triggers: Revenue growth falls below 10% or operating-income growth slows materially.
Operating margin falls below 45% or operating cash-flow growth turns negative.
views.thesis: MSFT combines 16.7% revenue growth with 20.9% operating-income growth, 60.4% operating-cash-flow growth and a 47.1% operating margin, while long-term debt is just 5.3% of assets. Despite the reported 9.8% ROE, the operating and balance-sheet profile supports a strong overweight.

change_triggers: Revenue or net-income growth falls below 20%, or gross-profit growth materially trails revenue.
Gross margin falls below 70% or leverage rises substantially from 0.36x liabilities-to-equity.
views.thesis: NVDA shows exceptional 62.5% revenue and 65.3% net-income growth, with a 73.4% gross margin, 63.2% operating margin and only 0.36x liabilities-to-equity leverage. The strong fundamentals justify a strong overweight, subject to evidence that this growth and margin profile persists.

change_triggers: Operating-income growth remains near zero or turns negative despite continued revenue growth.
Operating margin falls below 8% or ROE does not improve from 5.7%.
views.thesis: Revenue grew 13.4% and operating cash flow 36.8%, with modest leverage and $66.92B cash against $50.74B long-term debt. However, operating income grew only 0.1%, the 9.7% operating margin is limited, and ROE is 5.7%, supporting only a modest overweight.

change_triggers: Revenue and net-income year-on-year declines reverse into sustained growth.
ROE rises materially above 2.9% or operating cash-flow growth turns positive.
views.thesis: XOM has weakening fundamentals: revenue fell 5.2%, net income fell 12.3%, operating cash flow fell 11.7% in the cited quarter, and ROE is only 2.9%. The 0.71x liabilities-to-equity leverage is reasonable, but insufficient to offset declining growth and profitability.

change_triggers: Revenue growth falls below 5% or net-income growth normalizes sharply without corresponding operating improvement.
ROE remains below 7% while leverage rises materially.
views.thesis: JNJ delivered 6.8% revenue growth, 7.6% gross-profit growth and 91.2% net-income growth, with a 69.6% gross margin. The low 6.5% ROE and 1.43x liabilities-to-equity leverage temper the case, resulting in a modest overweight.

change_triggers: Revenue growth turns negative or operating-income decline exceeds the current 6.5%.
Operating margin falls below 23% or operating cash-flow growth reverses.
views.thesis: PG offers defensive profitability with a 24.2% operating margin and cited operating-cash-flow growth of 25.7%, but revenue growth is only 1.5% while operating income and net income decline 6.5% and 6.7%. This deteriorating earnings trend supports a modest underweight.

change_triggers: Operating income and net income return to year-on-year growth.
Liabilities-to-equity falls materially below 3.54x or operating cash-flow decline reverses.
views.thesis: CAT revenue grew 9.5%, but operating income fell 3.0%, net income fell 6.7%, and cited operating cash flow fell 37.2%; liabilities-to-equity is also high at 3.54x. The 17.3% operating margin and 11.1% ROE do not offset the weakening earnings and cash profile.

change_triggers: Operating-income growth turns positive and operating cash-flow decline reverses.
Long-term debt falls below 35% of assets or liabilities-to-equity declines materially from 2.58x.
views.thesis: NEE has 10.4% revenue growth and 31.6% net-income growth, but operating income declined 11.5% and cited operating cash flow declined 10.0%. Low 4.5% ROE, 2.58x liabilities-to-equity leverage and long-term debt at 41.2% of assets support a moderate underweight.

change_triggers: Revenue or gross-profit growth turns negative, or operating-income growth falls materially below revenue growth.
Operating cash flow returns to sustained positive growth.
views.thesis: KO shows steady 5.1% revenue and 6.5% gross-profit growth, while operating income rose 58.6% and margins are strong at 32.0%; however, the cited operating-cash-flow result was deeply negative and down 1085.2% year on year. This supports only a slight overweight pending cash-generation confirmation.
